title: Inbox
ransomTip: Ransom notes land better with a clear amount, a firm deadline and no more than one threat per paragraph. Cutting letters out of newspapers is charming but slow, so the editor does it for you.
heroTauntReceived: {{hero}} writes: "You'll never get away with this."
spamExplain: Threats that are vague, misspelled or addressed to "Dear Villain" go to Spam automatically. Real heroes always use your full title. If a threat turns out to be sincere, move it back to the inbox.
emptyBody: No ransom replies, no taunts, no complaints. Either everyone fears you or the lair Wi-Fi is down again.
deleteThreadConfirm: Delete this thread? The hero will still remember what you said.
